text: REJECT: `JudgeAsync` most likely still exceeds the threshold, since by my count (assuming Sonar-style cognitive complexity) it comes to about 17: eight early-return `if`s, six ternaries (one nested, costing +2) in the `moved`, `settled` and `reason` expressions, and the `&&` sequence inside the `unmeasured` lambda; behaviour looks preserved, but I did not build or run the metric tool.
